column7: channelToAPI returned the decrypted channel URL (a bearer credential: the token is in the path) on create, list and get to every alerts.write caller, so the narrower alert_operator persona could read every channel's webhook token with a plain GET. Confirmed red before the fix through the real router as a user holding only alerts.write (the SUPERSECRETTOKEN path appeared in list, get and update bodies). Fixed with contract v2: only the create response returns the full URL; list, get and update return scheme+host with the path elided plus url_set, an update that omits url keeps the stored credential and an explicit url replaces it, and the web edit form no longer prefills or resubmits the URL.
